note: Popular overland trips from Singapore by coach, bus or train. Times are typical door-to-door ranges including the Woodlands or Tuas checkpoint on a normal day; weekend and holiday queues can add 1–3 hours. Places that also have a flight (or a flight plus transfer) keep it; this adds the overland option. Compiled October 2026 from operator listings, booking sites and travel guides; check the operator before travelling. Update when the RTS Link opens (expected February 2027).

JB–Singapore RTS Link start (Malay Mail, 2 Oct 2026)

destinations.name: Johor Bahru
destinations.from: Queen Street, Kranji or Woodlands (bus); Woodlands Train Checkpoint (KTM Shuttle Tebrau)
destinations.notes: The Shuttle Tebrau train is about 5 minutes across the Causeway; buses run round the clock (CW2). Weekend peaks can add 1–3 hours at the checkpoints. The RTS Link (Woodlands North to Bukit Chagar, about 5 minutes) is expected to open in February 2027.

destinations.name: Desaru Coast
destinations.from: Pickup from home or a meeting point (shared 7-seater shuttles)
destinations.notes: About 1.5 hours by road from Woodlands Checkpoint; Causeway jams can stretch it to 5 hours. Shared shuttles often need a minimum group size.

destinations.name: Muar
destinations.from: Golden Mile Tower (direct), or JB Larkin Terminal (Mayang Sari Express, about 3 hours)
destinations.notes: One direct coach a day; more options via Larkin in Johor Bahru.

destinations.name: Malacca
destinations.from: Queen Street, Golden Mile, HarbourFront or Boon Lay
destinations.notes: Most coaches arrive at Melaka Sentral; fares rise at weekends and on public holidays.

destinations.name: Port Dickson
destinations.notes: About 3.5 hours by car; direct coaches run most days, arriving at beach resorts.

sources.name: How to travel from Singapore to Port Dickson (Dive into Malaysia)

destinations.name: Mersing
destinations.from: Golden Mile Complex (direct), or JB Larkin Terminal
destinations.notes: Gateway to Tioman and the Mersing islands by ferry. Some coaches stop at the bus terminal, a short taxi from the jetty. Island ferries are reduced or suspended in the northeast monsoon (about November to February).

destinations.name: Kuala Lumpur
destinations.from: Golden Mile, HarbourFront, Queen Street and suburban pickups
destinations.notes: Frequent departures through the day; arrival at TBS or city-centre stops depending on the operator.

sources.name: Singapore to Kuala Lumpur by bus (GeckoRoutes)
Singapore–Kuala Lumpur express buses (Rail Travel Station)

destinations.name: Genting Highlands
destinations.from: Golden Mile and suburban pickups (Woodlands, Jurong East, Tampines and others)
destinations.notes: Coaches arrive at the Awana terminal; morning and late-night departures.

destinations.name: Ipoh
destinations.notes: A few direct coaches a day to Terminal Meru Raya.

destinations.name: Cameron Highlands
destinations.from: Golden Mile Tower or Boon Lay (overnight)
destinations.notes: Overnight coaches to Tanah Rata; some trips change in Kuala Lumpur.

destinations.name: Penang
destinations.from: Golden Mile and other city pickups (evening departures)

destinations.name: Kuantan
destinations.notes: East coast: the northeast monsoon (about November to February) brings heavy rain and rough seas.
